Publisher confirmed: Wiley (Wiley Periodicals LLC), open access, published on behalf of the Orthopaedic Research Society (ORS). No publisher migration found — still Wiley.

Blinding: the current guide states (via Google-indexed snippet) 'Manuscripts are single-blind peer reviewed.' Single-blind ⇒ double_blind=false and no title-page scrub / metadata scrub required. This matches the conservative default, so zero fabrication risk.

Article types: guide states 'The journal publishes original research articles, reviews and perspectives.' Encoded original_research + review. 'Perspectives' OMITTED — no clean schema slot (opinion/commentary; not narrative_review/editorial/letter). Reviews are noted as requiring a pre-submission proposal (query + abstract + outline) for unsolicited reviews.
ORCID: guide 'encourages the submitting author (only) to provide an ORCID iD... encouraged but not mandatory' ⇒ misc.orcid_required=false (corroborated, not a guess).
cover_letter_required set false (unstated in reachable sources → conservative default; NOT verified against the live guide).

abstract.structured=false is a CONSERVATIVE DEFAULT, not verified — the blocked guide's abstract structure/word cap could not be read. Word limits, abstract max, keyword rules, and all per-type caps left null (word_limits and sections are empty maps).
